move.subject: Re: New stainless pump shaft SH-220: award one of two suppliers
move.body:
Dear your company team,

You go straight from your quote back to the machines—it sounds like you value a practical discussion without unnecessary back-and-forth. We want a competitive agreement grounded in the part-specific cost estimate and planned demand. What flexibility in payment, lead time or shipping arrangements would help you sharpen your price?

We confirm a binding volume of 6,000 units per year for 24 months. We have an offer at EUR 16.00 per unit (offer:DEMO-C1-0). Our should-cost estimate for this part is on record (cost:part:SH-220). Our demand forecast for this part is on record (fc:SH-220@2026-09).

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 12.51 per unit, 30 days payment, 42 days lead time, DAP). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Attached: our monthly call-off schedule for the full contract term.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:

We checked the rival quote data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We have free capacity for your parts. Our Lieferzeit is 42 days. With overtime we can deliver in 21 days, at a premium. 

Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price. 

We can do 15.40 with the 42 days lead time and DAP delivery you asked for. In return for that price and delivery, we need 14 days payment terms. 

Our offer is a price of €15.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, Lieferzeit 42 days, delivery DAP. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 14 days net: €15.30 per unit. A price of €15.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, Lieferzeit 42 days, delivery DAP.

Gruß
Claudia Aigner
Owner, Demo Drehteile GmbH
